annual.label: Average yearly repair cost for the Caprice, all years (RepairPal)

maint.every: About every 3,000–5,000 miles on conventional oil (check the owner's manual)
maint.note: KBB has no Caprice-specific price; it suggests about 5,000 miles for conventional oil but defers to the owner's manual on older engines.

maint.every: Have pads checked about every 10,000 miles; replace when worn
maint.note: YourMechanic Caprice average: about $195 ($55 parts, $140 labor); its year-specific Caprice estimates run about $307-$480. Rotors cost extra if they need replacing.
KBB has no Caprice-specific price; its general battery range is about $45-$250, and it says a battery averages about six years, or 3-4 in extreme heat or cold.
